subject: UefiCpuPkg: Set up 256 IDT Descs in SEC/PEI/SMM
reasons: Core commit of a series that systematically replaces local CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM=256, CPU_EXCEPTION_NUM=32, and SEC_IDT_ENTRY_COUNT=34 magic-number defines with X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM across 17 files in UefiCpuPkg
Pattern is mechanically uniform: every occurrence of these local defines in array sizes, sizeof(), loop bounds, and IDT limit calculations is replaced with X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM
High repetitiveness: 17 files changed, same textual substitution applied throughout
candidate_pattern: Replace CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM, CPU_EXCEPTION_NUM, SEC_IDT_ENTRY_COUNT integer literals with X86_CPU_INTERRUPT_NUM in array declarations, sizeof expressions, loop bounds, and IDT limit expressions
